$comment: Operator decision log (scripts/analysis/decision-log.mjs; Spec 124 R-HK). Imported verbatim from the committed chat record docs/reports/decisions/raw/2026-10-20-chat-batch-b/2026-10-20-batch-b.json. `decision_vocab`, `routing` (the register and row that record each decision), `amendments` and `options` are added by the lane and are not the operator's text; everything else is re-derived from `source.raw` by `--check`.

decisions.question: 150.7.60.20(6)(A) mis-citation
decisions.recommendation: Drop the M-193 (Coxwell map area) mis-citation so the row closes as M-198 owed to P5.13, like (6)(C).

decisions.question: M-219 remainder: laneway suite step-back above 4.0 m
decisions.recommendation: Key the 1.5 m step-back above 4.0 m (150.8.60.20(3)(C)) as its own target (e.g. upper_side_setback_m, laneway suite only); the whole-building side setback stays 1.0 m; Layer 3 does the step-back geometry.

decisions.question: M-220 absent-article arm (19 cells)
decisions.recommendation: Let rule 7a treat a target as unregulated by absence when only lawfully-existing or ancillary-only units carry it; then confirm absence for R/RT length, RT depth and main wall (M-186), RM houseplex (M-204 not_applicable); R coverage and RD semi depth per the 19-cell ratchet list.

decisions.question: O-7 main-wall share tiers and attic test target shape
decisions.recommendation: Give the main-wall share tiers their own minimum targets, and key the 10.5.40.40(1) attic test as four threshold-definition targets (1.4 m, 80 %, 2.0 m, 10.0 m2), or allow a bound per statement — whichever the keying lane finds smaller; the operator approves the target shape.

decisions.question: M-223(1) not_buildable scenario status
decisions.recommendation: Amend Spec 68 §11.1 and the vocab together to add not_buildable and the prefixed status forms.

decisions.question: Q-7 scope: 10 extra report fields
decisions.recommendation: Add to the Spec 100 whitelist with the Q-7 set: parcel.lot.zone_class_label, exception_number, is_irregular, is_corner_lot, is_through_lot, abuts_laneway, centroid_lat, centroid_lng, overlays, neighbourhood_name.

decisions.question: M-229 with no permitted maximum GFA
decisions.recommendation: Where no maximum GFA applies (FSI not applicable / unlimited), nothing is excluded; buildable area unchanged. Explained to operator as settled, no ruling needed; recorded for completeness.

decisions.question: Canopy height keyed as building height (150.7.60.60(5)(A), 150.8.60.60(5)(A))
decisions.recommendation: Per the operator's existing 'disclose' answers, make these disclosure-only and remove them from the suite building height keying.
